main_idea: GRPO training improved Qwen3.8-27B-Medium’s DeepSWE pass rate by 11.3 points.
ideas: GRPO raised DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
The training used eight attempts per task.
Tasks came from enterprise codebases across five languages.
summary: The chart is clear and complete, but header labels, separate statistics, method cards, and footer branding add clutter.
